gold_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.caller_symbol_id
FROM code.calls c
JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = c.callee_symbol_id
WHERE s.name = 'upsert_table_term'
ORDER BY c.caller_symbol_id;
